description: The Oct 16 Muscat sit-in reported by Al-Masa Press is a documented occurrence, but its stated demands address Israeli/US actions and Palestine, not Oman’s state or policy; it is excluded from own-state target scope. The OCHRD annual-report body open failed with an internal error and unrelated redirect, which was not followed or retried. Later exact-phrase search of its indexed excerpt identifies the quoted Green March passage as 17 January 2011, not Q4 2024. No Q4 claim relies on that PDF. A V4 targeted October 2024 federation-magazine archive search returned a search-only excerpt listing labor-policy articles; it does not verify an executed public gathering or establish absence.
required_followup: Continue independent regional/local, civil-society and sector-specific reporting for actual gatherings, attendance and demands; check onset/continuity and official baseline.
